settings.name: Example Wedding Supplies
settings.about: Wedding and ceremony supplies: fresh flower garlands, traditional ceremony items and wedding packages, for pickup.

faq.a: Phone orders are for pickup. For shipping, order on our website.

faq.q: Can I change the flowers or colours on a garland?
faq.a: Often, yes. Tell us what you'd like and we'll get back to you with a price.

guides.title: What's needed for a Telugu wedding
guides.text: Most families need, by ceremony: Pelli Kuthuru and Mangala Snanam: haldi jewelry, turmeric, a decorated coconut. Kanyadanam: a Kanyadanam set (plate, kalasham, coconut). Jeelakarra Bellam: cumin and jaggery paste, the couple's garlands. Talambralu: Navaratna talambralu (coloured rice), two talambrala basins. Also common: basingalu for the couple, a sanapeeta, and pooja flowers. A wedding package covers most of this in one order.

guides.title: Choosing garlands
guides.text: Bride and groom garlands are sold as a pair. Lengths: 4 feet suits most couples; 5 feet for a fuller look. Fresh garlands are made 1 to 2 days before pickup and keep 2 days refrigerated. Order at least 7 days ahead; garlands made in India need 21 days.
